title: Gather Motion
summary: A human-directed studio for short-form video, from brief and shot plan through review to a finished cut. Paper light and blue-black dark themes, drawn in one line weight with cut corners, rails and stations.

direction.product: A human-directed studio for short-form video, from brief and shot plan through review to a finished cut.
direction.character: A plotting table: the work is the subject and the interface is the instrument laid over it.
direction.world: Paper light and blue-black dark themes, drawn in one line weight with cut corners, rails and stations.
moments: Frames passing through the slash of the gather/motion wordmark on the landing.
Plan, Review and Deliver as stations on one line, with a sequence strip and take rail.
direction.signature: Cut corners as the only bezel; Space Grotesk headings, Inter reading text and Space Mono tags and figures.
voice: Keep accept or reject, select a take, approve plan and approve cut distinct.
Mono capitals are for state tags and rail numbers, never sentences.
